headline: Expanse Ruins Shift Hands While Mooring County Skirmishes Persist
war_summary: Since our previous edition, fighting in Weathered Expanse has reduced yet another fortified position to rubble, leaving Colonial defenders with five bases, Wardens with one, and three reduced to no-man's-land amid nearly two thousand casualties over the past two hours. In Mooring County, Colonial forces regained ground to secure three strategic bases against eight Warden holdings and one ruined bastion, even as vicious fighting at Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows exacted more than twenty-two hundred combined losses. Along Stlican Shelf, recent clashes over Briar and Breaker Town sparked three fresh ownership changes, consolidating eight bases under Colonial command to a lone Warden outpost. The sharp actions previously reported at Olavis Wake and Marban Hollow have fallen silent, with no fresh exchanges registered over the last two hours. Elsewhere, severe casualty exchanges persist without line movements, notably along the Nevish Line and across Dead Lands, where Warden losses sharply accelerated.
